entries.title: OpenAI Agents SDK orchestration and hosted multi-agent surfaces
entries.relationship: Confirms expanding orchestration and parallel-agent surfaces while leaving portable shared-state correctness evidence outside Agent Braid's initial scope claim.
entries.decision: Track trace-adapter requirements after M2 contracts stabilize; do not add a provider dependency now.

entries.title: Agent2Agent protocol specification
entries.relationship: Task identity, artifacts, versioning, idempotency and extensions are relevant to a future AIM adapter, but protocol interoperability does not establish semantic independence.
entries.decision: Retain A2A as a post-M2 adapter candidate and preserve one-way translation into AIM.

entries.title: Model Context Protocol security best practices
entries.relationship: Authorization, session, local-server and SSRF risks reinforce the existing gate against external traces or write-capable adapters before dedicated privacy and security review.
entries.decision: Carry these threat classes into future adapter requirements; no MCP runtime is introduced in M0.5.

entries.title: NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit 1.8 overview
entries.relationship: Current profiling, observability, evaluation, MCP and A2A support make NeMo a future trace-adapter comparison point rather than a core dependency.
entries.decision: Defer installation and adapter work until the M2 evidence contracts are stable.

entries.title: CoAgent: Concurrency Control for Multi-Agent Systems
entries.relationship: Directly adjacent work proposes advisory concurrency control and reported workload results; its semantics, tool inverses and empirical claims have not been reproduced here.
entries.decision: Add to the M2 comparison backlog and seek artifact-level reproduction before making novelty or performance claims.

entries.title: Position: Multi-Agent Systems Should Prioritize Concurrency Control
entries.relationship: The position aligns with Agent Braid's problem framing but is not evidence of demand, priority or correctness of this project's approach.
entries.decision: Cite only as an adjacent position and keep independent technical validation requirements unchanged.
